cards.ex: She sized him up the moment he walked in, noticing his expensive watch and confident posture.
cards.exUz: U uni xonaga kirishi bilan baholadi, uning qimmat soati va ishonchli qiyofasiga e'tibor berdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir tashqi ko'rinishi, xatti-harakati orqali uning kimligini aniqlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's got such a poker face; it's impossible to tell what he's thinking.
cards.exUz: Uning yuzi shunchalik betarafki, nima o'ylayotganini bilishning iloji yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday his-tuyg'uni ko'rsatmaydigan yuz ifodasi, betaraflik.

cards.ex: Her nervous laughter gave away her guilt.
cards.exUz: Uning asabiy kulgusi aybini oshkor qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani, ayniqsa, sirni tasodifan oshkor qilish, ko'rsatib qo'yish.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what he really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutayotganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasini o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Gapirilmagan narsalarni, yashirin ma'nolarni tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His 'tell' when he's lying is that he starts sweating.
cards.exUz: U yolg'on gapirganda uning 'belgisi' terlashni boshlashidir.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining his-tuyg'ularini yashirishga urinishiga qaramay, seziladigan belgi.

cards.ex: She's keeping her cards close to her chest about her future plans.
cards.exUz: U kelajakdagi rejalarini sir saqlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z rejalaringiz yoki fikrlaringizni yashirish, sir saqlash.

cards.ex: His unusual behavior might raise some eyebrows at the office.
cards.exUz: Uning g'ayrioddiy xatti-harakatlari ofisda hayrat uyg'otishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarda ajablanish, norozilik yoki hayrat uyg'otish.

cards.ex: Her silence spoke volumes about her disappointment.
cards.exUz: Uning sukuti uning umidsizlik haqida ko'p narsani aytdi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar ishlatilmasdan turib, biror narsa haqida ko'p ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: He's such an open book; you always know what he's thinking.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik ochiq kitobki, u nima o'ylayotganini doim bilasiz.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsani yashirmaydigan, hamma biladigan odam.

cards.ex: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.
cards.exUz: Menda nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligi haqida ichki tuyg'u bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa to'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri ekanligini his qilish, sezgi.

cards.ex: We waited with bated breath to hear the results.
cards.exUz: Natijalarni eshitish uchun nafasimizni ichimizga yutib kutdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir juda qiziqish bilan va xavotir bilan kutish.

cards.ex: The movie had me on the edge of my seat the whole time.
cards.exUz: Film meni butun vaqt davomida hayajonda ushlab turdi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari hayajonlangan yoki xavotirda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He got cold feet and backed out of the deal at the last minute.
cards.exUz: U qo'rqib ketdi va oxirgi daqiqada kelishuvdan voz kechdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishdan oldin birdan qo'rqib ketish, ikkilanish.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerakligini bilar edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlaringizning oqibatlariga duch kelish.

cards.ex: I needed to get that off my chest; I feel much better now.
cards.exUz: Men buni aytishim kerak edi; hozir o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir xavotirlanib yurgan narsani aytish, yengillashish.

cards.ex: It was hard to keep a straight face when he told that joke.
cards.exUz: U bu hazilni aytganida jiddiy turish qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Kulmaslikka harakat qilish, jiddiy ifoda saqlash.

cards.ex: Tell me what happened; I'm all ears.
cards.exUz: Nima bo'lganini ayt; men diqqat bilan eshitaman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan tinglashga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: We don't have a plan; we'll just play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Bizda reja yo'q; biz shunchaki vaziyatga qarab harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm sticking my neck out for you; don't let me down.
cards.exUz: Men siz uchun tavakkal qilyapman; meni xafa qilmang.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni xavf ostiga qo'yish, tavakkal qilish.

cards.ex: She turned up her nose at the cheap wine.
cards.exUz: U arzon vinoni mensimadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yoki kimnidir mensimaslik, past nazar bilan qarash.

cards.ex: If I can put my two cents in, I think you should sell the car.
cards.exUz: Agar fikrimni bildirishim mumkin bo'lsa, menimcha siz mashinani sotishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni bildirish, maslahat berish (ko'pincha so'ralmagan holda).

cards.ex: The new job keeps me on my toes.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish meni sergak ushlab turadi.
cards.uzDef: Sergak, ehtiyotkor va harakatga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm all thumbs when it comes to fixing things.
cards.exUz: Biror narsani tuzatishga kelganda, men qo'limdan hech narsa kelmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'llaringiz bilan biror narsa qilishda noqulay, chaqqon emas.

cards.ex: I bent over backwards to help him, and he didn't even say thank you.
cards.exUz: Men unga yordam berish uchun jon kuydirdim, lekin u hatto rahmat ham aytmadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun juda ko'p harakat qilmoq, jon kuydirmoq.

cards.ex: Don't always take everything at face value; do some research.
cards.exUz: Har doim ham hamma narsaga so'ziga ishonmang; biroz tadqiqot qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rost deb qabul qilish, shubhalanmaslik.

cards.ex: She looks down her nose at anyone who didn't go to a top university.
cards.exUz: U yuqori universitetda o'qimaganlarga yuqoridan qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni boshqalardan ustun deb hisoblash, kibr bilan qarash.

cards.ex: I'm finally starting to get a handle on this new software.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat bu yangi dasturni o'zlashtirishni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunishni boshlash, o'zlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: His speech was completely off the cuff, but it was still very good.
cards.exUz: Uning nutqi butunlay tayyorgarliksiz edi, lekin u hali ham juda yaxshi edi.
cards.uzDef: Tayyorgarliksiz, oldindan rejalashtirmasdan qilingan.

cards.ex: The police turned a blind eye to the illegal gambling.
cards.exUz: Politsiya noqonuniy qimor o'yinlariga ko'z yumdi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noqonuniy narsani ko'rmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I am just pulling your leg, you won the competition!
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki hazillashyapman, siz musobaqada g'olib bo'ldingiz!
cards.uzDef: Sizni hazillashib aldayotganini aytish
